sentence: Animatable and Relightable Gaussians jointly optimise geometry, appearance and a relighting decomposition on multi-view captures, reaching 30.6143 dB NVS on AvatarReX against 23.2475 dB for the AvatarReX baseline, 30.3607 dB on actorsHQ against 3DGS-Avatar's 28.7836 dB and GaussianAvatar's 26.9497 dB, and 31.6339 dB under relighting, at a cost of about two days on an RTX 4090 and 4–10 seconds per frame for relighting [cited].
ref: Z Li, et al. Animatable and relightable gaussians for high-fidelity human avatar modeling. arXiv preprint, 2023. https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.16096

sentence: Its explicitly stated motive is scalability — no MLP is applied per Gaussian — and its results on the deliberately hard Unbiased4D capture (22.348 dB on the synthetic cactus against Nerfies at 17.36 dB and HexPlane at 16.327 dB) demonstrate the value of strong priors when multi-view cues are weak; ablation shows the basis size K is critical, with K=2 collapsing to 15.67 dB and K=25 optimal at 22.348 dB [cited].

sentence: Modelling CFG training as a masked conditional/unconditional score-matching risk, it proves via a "diffused Taylor approximation" that conditional distribution estimation in TV distance attains O(n^{−β/(d+d_y+2β)} (log n)^{max(19/2,(β+2)/2)}) under its Assumption 3.3, matching a minimax lower bound of ≳ n^{−β/(d+2β)} for d_y = 0 [cited].
